subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should this PR establish the experimental installed-agent export contract while the Claws RFC still treats the implementation stack as prototype evidence?
rationale: Even after the concrete portability defect is repaired, the new CLI and reusable serialized package format require maintainer acceptance of their ownership and compatibility obligations.

options.title: Hold for RFC acceptance
options.body: Fix portability and proof now, but keep the implementation draft until maintainers accept the export contract.

options.title: Accept incubation compatibility
options.body: Land behind the experimental gate while explicitly owning migration of exported package shapes if the RFC changes.

options.title: Pause the export slice
options.body: Stop this branch if implementation should wait until the broader lifecycle contract is finalized.

recommendation.title: Hold for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Fix portability and proof now, but keep the implementation draft until maintainers accept the export contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied the clearest available product-model and schema-boundary acceptance review for the RFC.
